name.full: Trattoria Command — Giuseppe's manager cockpit for Microsoft 365 Copilot

description.short: Giuseppe's cockpit in Copilot — tonight, reports, forecasts, reservations.
description.full: Giuseppe is the pizzaiolo of the Copilot Pizza Factory — and inside Microsoft 365 Copilot he wears his manager hat. Ask about tonight's service, today's business report, what will most likely be a problem soon, or the reservation book, and instead of a wall of text Copilot renders a living cockpit: a compact inline card for a glance, expanding to a fullscreen war room with table pressure, revenue pace, the crystal ball and the pre-order book. FORNO ROSSO branded, dark-mode aware, and entirely rendered by a SharePoint Copilot component (SPFx 1.24 PREVIEW).
